name: Stream Chat
description: Stream Chat is an embedded messaging platform for customer-owned applications, providing users, channels, messages, moderation, roles, permissions, and real-time chat SDKs.
agentUseSummary: Stream Chat cannot currently be connected as a Relay-owned account integration because server access requires a customer application's dashboard API key and full-access API secret, not delegated OAuth. User JWTs identify users inside that customer's application and are minted only after the customer's own backend authenticates them; they are not delegated account authority.

blocked.label: Connect a Stream account
blocked.description: Stream Chat does not publish a distributable delegated account OAuth, consent, callback, refresh, or per-installation revocation lifecycle for Relay.

blocked.label: Custody an application secret
blocked.description: The dashboard API secret gives server-side code full access to the customer's Stream application and must not be represented as a Relay-owned OAuth grant.

blocked.label: Relabel a user JWT as OAuth
blocked.description: User JWTs are minted by the customer's backend after its own user authentication and authorize only that identity under application permissions.

blocked.label: Access Stream Chat data
blocked.description: Users, channels, messages, members, roles, permissions, moderation, files, exports, settings, and every application read/write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported delegated account contract or a separately approved user-owned application-secret product decision.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported delegated Stream Chat account contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported delegated Stream Chat account contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Stream Chat documents customer application API key/secret server access and in-application user JWTs rather than delegated account OAuth. Valid server credentials bypass client permissions and allow the complete application API.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Stream credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only after Stream publishes a distributable delegated account contract, or after a separate product/security decision approves a user-owned key/secret integration for one named application with explicit rotation and revocation operations.

evidence.supports: Stream documents dashboard API key/secret server initialization, states that the secret provides full Chat API access, and describes customer backends minting user tokens.
Stream documents user JWT generation with the application secret after the customer's own authentication flow, not delegated account OAuth.
Stream states that permission checks apply to client calls and that valid server-side API key/secret access allows everything.
Stream explains that the application secret enables server access, must never be exposed client-side, and can perform user, channel, admin, and moderation operations.
